name: How much does it cost to frame a new door opening?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to frame a new door opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to frame a new door opening varies based on several factors, including the wall's type (load-bearing vs. non-load-bearing), the size of the opening, and any required structural modifications. It typically includes labor for demolition, framing material costs, and construction. Prices can range depending on complexity and local labor rates. A simple non-load-bearing interior door might cost less than a larger exterior opening requiring significant structural work. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies based on wall type, opening size, and structural needs; it includes labor and materials. An on-site assessment provides an accurate estimate.
